response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name WHERE avg_amount IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount AS average_budgeted_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS difference_above_mean, p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg
